issues.fix: Resolve the municipal boundary (Lincoln Ave exists in both Jamesburg and Monroe) or remove the entry so it does not breach the 'Monroe Township addresses only' rule.

issues.fix: Treat ICC, Best Heating and Van Demark as a possible related-operator cluster; confirm each trade name separately or merge.

issues.problem: Two firms at one address with 609-619-0051 / 609-619-0314 numbers, which look patterned (street-address-derived). Both still rest on a single Cylex page.
issues.fix: Keep them flagged as unverified; require an independent source (registration, review profile, phone answer) before any outreach.

issues.claim: Website fields left empty for businesses that do have sites
issues.problem: Searches surfaced live sites for entries recorded without one: Plumbing Solutions Inc (plumbingsolutionsonline.com, which lists 142 Applegarth Rd), G7 Automation LLC (g7automation.com, 104 Interchange Plaza Ste 101).

issues.claim: Roughly 40 entries rest on a single Cylex listing
issues.problem: Cylex returned HTTP 403 to direct fetching again in this check, so those entries could not be re-opened. The mapper disclosed this, but the list still mixes confirmed and single-directory entries in one flat structure.
issues.fix: Split confirmed vs. single-directory entries into separate sheets so the outreach team does not treat them equally.
